# Clay Smith

> > Personal website of Clay Smith, a software engineer exploring serverless architectures, AI coding agents, and creative technical experiments with AWS Lambda, Claude Code, and Rust.

This site showcases Clay's technical writing on cloud infrastructure, developer tools, and AI-assisted development. Topics range from practical AWS Lambda tutorials to experimental projects like TCP/IP over CloudWatch Logs and AI-powered historical chatbots.

## Key Topics

- AWS Lambda
- Claude Code
- Serverless architectures
- Rust programming
- Task orchestration
- Coding agents
- Developer experience
- Cloud sandboxing
- SSH tunneling
- Backend systems
- Python and Go
- Static site generation (Zola)
- Browser automation (Selenium)
- Autonomous agents
- Open source

- [The unexpected joy of Claude Code on your iPhone](https://clay.fyi/blog/iphone-claude-code-context-coding): Mobile coding workflow with Claude Code, Tailscale, and devcontainers

## AWS Lambda & Serverless

- [SSH-ing into your AWS Lambda Functions](https://clay.fyi/blog/ssh-ing-into-aws-lambda-functions): Reverse SSH tunneling technique for debugging AWS Lambda containers
- [Running Selenium and Headless Chrome on AWS Lambda](https://clay.fyi/blog/running-selenium-headless-chrome-aws-lambda): Browser automation on AWS Lambda using Selenium and Headless Chrome
- [TCP/IP over Amazon Cloudwatch Logs](https://clay.fyi/blog/tcp-ip-over-cloudwatch-logs): Proof-of-concept TCP/IP networking through CloudWatch Logs in Lambda
